project_name: NFL 1st Quarter & 1st Half ML Prediction Dashboard
theme: Dark Green & Gold Tactical Luxury (Performance Sports Analytics)

sections.description: LLC Brand Header + Route indicator /sports/nfl + Live vs Sample Data Badge + Top Stat Bar
Season & Week Selector (2026 Week 8 default), Market Filter (All, Q1 ML, Q1 Spread, Q1 Total, 1H ML, 1H Spread, 1H Total), Min EV Threshold Filter, Sportsbook Filter
Top High-Value Signals (Edge >= +4.0% EV) highlighted with glowing gold borders and quick bet-builder context
Grid of Week 8 Games showing team logos/names, Kickoff time, Predicted Q1 score, Predicted 1H score, Model Fair Lines, Best Edge Pill, and 'Compare 7 Sportsbooks' modal trigger
Modal/Drawer comparing moneyline, spread, and total across DraftKings, FanDuel, BetMGM, Caesars, ESPN BET, Fanatics, Bet365 for Q1 and 1H with highlighted model edges
Collapsible XGBoost Model Architecture panel showing features (EPA/play, neutral pass rate, pace, turnover margin), backtest MAE (Q1: 3.1 pts, 1H: 4.8 pts), and data sources (nflreadpy 2018-2025)

component_instructions.testing_attributes: All buttons, inputs, tabs, selects, and modal triggers MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Use dark green (#04120B / #0A2216) as the primary base with metallic gold (#E5C158 / #D4AF37) for edge highlights.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds on headers or dialog overlays.
Ensure numbers for scores, odds (+110, -115), spread (-2.5), total (O/U 10.5), and EV (+5.2%) are rendered in monospace font.
Include all 7 requested sportsbooks: DraftKings, FanDuel, BetMGM, Caesars, ESPN BET, Fanatics, Bet365 in odds comparison tables.
Ensure default displayed week is 2026 NFL Week 8 with clear week selector.
All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes.
